title: Girls und Panzer Franchise Gets 2 New Games
content:
D3Publisher and G Holdings each announced a new game for the Girls und Panzer franchise on Friday. D3Publisher is developing the Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival game, while G Holdings is developing the Girls und Panzer : Bokosuka Rush game. D3 Publisher is streaming the below trailer for Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival .

Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival will launch for the Switch 2 in Japan in 2027. The same team that handled the Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match PlayStation 4 game is also working on the new game. The game will focus on controllable tank battles, but will also allow players to control Miho and walk around a recreation of the story's Ōarai town (itself based on the real-life town of Ōarai).

Girls und Panzer : Bokosuka Rush will be a smartphone game. G Holdings did not reveal a release date for the game. G Holdings describes the game as being set in the "Boko Museum" that appears in the Girls und Panzer der Film anime. In the game, Miho and Alice visit the museum and try out the "tank simulator" there, only to be confronted with Boko as their enemy. The game will allow players to mix up crew and the tanks they operate, with crew getting progressively better, and unlocking more abilities for tanks.

Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match launched for the PS4 in Japan and Southeast Asia (with English text support) in February 2018. The Girls und Panzer Dream Tank Match DX Switch version shipped in Japan and Southeast Asia (with English text support) in February 2019.

title: Crunchyroll, HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier Partner to Produce Anime of 'Around' 15 Webtoons
content:
Crunchyroll will exclusively stream the anime made through this partnership in select territories.

HAYATE Inc. was founded in March 2025 and is headquartered in Tokyo. Aniplex 's Masanori Miyake leads the venture as Chairman and CEO along with President and COO Leo Watanabe . The staff is composed of Aniplex and Crunchyroll employees. HAYATE is focusing specifically on planning, developing, and producing anime content for Crunchyroll 's streaming platform worldwide. In April, HAYATE acquired all shares of anime studio Lay-duce , making it a wholly owned subsidiary. HAYATE is overseeing the production of the upcoming Ghost of Tsushima: Legends ( Ghost of Tsushima: Kuroudo Kitan ) anime series.

LINE Digital Frontier CEO Shin-bae Kim had announced in February 2025 that the company would produce 20 animated adaptations of webtoons that year, significantly expanding its webtoon-based IP business. LINE Digital Frontier is the operator of LINE Manga , the Japanese subsidiary of Naver Webtoon.

LINE Manga has been aggressively pursuing webtoon adaptations since 2024. In 2024, it produced 12 adaptations, a significant increase from just one in 2022 and two in 2023.

title: Comisma Enters Agreement With Akili International to Produce Live-Action Film of Zukyun x Bakyun Manga
content:
Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and describes the story:

Dan and Lyla are two highly trained, elite assassins who work together on the most dangerous of missions. They've only ever interacted on the job, so when Dan suddenly confesses his love for Lyla, the two find themselves up against something they have zero training for: romance! With their lives and hearts on the line, can this killer couple continue breaking bones without breaking each other's hearts?

Yuzuriha launched the manga in Comisma's GANMA! manga platform in October 2023, and ended it in September 2025. Comisma published the manga's fifth compiled book volume digitally on January 1. Seven Seas Entertainment will release the first volume in September 2027.

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, January Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of author Kennoji and artist R_ringo 's My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! ( Dōkyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishō ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu ) manga unveiled a teaser promotional video on Friday. The teaser announces the anime's cast and January 2027 television premiere.

Ai Kakuma as Liza Parsandra

Seena Hoshiki as Eugene Dawson

Hitomi Ueda as Cordelia Dawson

Azusa Tsujimori as Erin Toa

Tomoyo Takayanagi as Meris Eclipse

Miyu Tomita as Fiona Rosso

Minami Takahashi as Lumiere Theomere

Hitomi Ueda is also the anime's narrator.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga and will release the manga starting in June 2027 as part of its Ghost Ship imprint. Seven Seas Entertainment describes the series:

One Man's desire to become strong leads him to a powerful Sword Saint. While she's got plenty of physical prowess and strength, her ditzy personality and stunning looks make her hard to resist! A fun and sexy rom-com manga that will get your blood flowing. Her stats? Stacked. Her power? Unmatched. Her looks? Deadly gorgeous. There's no better mentor to have than Liza Parsandra, a powerful Sword Saint, and Eugene Dawson is the lucky man chosen to be her trainee! But living and training with someone like Liza has unique challenges, especially when it comes to her scatterbrained nature. Between Liza's ditzy moments and tendency towards skinship while training, Eugene has a hard time focusing on the right sword when he's constantly in contact with the beautiful swordswoman!

Masayoshi Nishida ( Princess Knight , Little Astro Boy , Makina-san’s a Love Bot?! ) is directing the anime at Wolfsbane and Lightbox. Noriyoshi Sasaki is the series' technical director. Yōhei Kashii ( TenPuru , My One-Hit Kill Sister , Makina-san’s a Love Bot?! ) is in charge of series scripts. Ichirō Tanaka is designing the characters, with Ayame Etō and Yusho Hayakawa are the sub-character designers. Hayakawa is also the chief animation director. 12sound is composing the music. WWWave Corporation 's Deregula anime label is producing the anime.

Kazuki Kuwahara is directing the sound. Kumiko Yoshikawa is designing the props, weapons, and small objects. Norifumi Nakamura is directing the art. Fuyuto Muraguchi is the color key artist. Kōhei Ogawa is the compositing director of photography at Gekkō . Nao Kawakami is editing, and is also credited for production supervision. Atomu Saegusa (also known as Takatora Shiomi ) is credited for setting development. Kōhei Motokawa is the animation producer.

The manga launched on the KadoComi website in March 2024. The second volume shipped on January 23.

Kennoji 's other works include: Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist , The Girl I Saved on the Train Turned Out to Be My Childhood Friend , I Time-Traveled and Confessed to Ｍy Teacher Crush , and Hazure Skill . Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist inspired a television anime in July 2021.

title: Animator Kenichirou Katsura Dies at 59
content:
Kenichirou Katsura , known for his character designs for Macross 7 and Knight's & Magic , died on September 30. He was 59. A funeral service was held by his close relatives.

Satoko Miyachi , his wife and fellow animator, announced the news on X (formerly Twitter) on Monday, stating that Katsura died while undergoing medical treatment.

"Animator Kenichirou Katsura died on September 30 while receiving medical treatment. We offer our deepest gratitude to the fans who loved the works and designs he was involved in during his lifetime, as well as to the production companies, staff, and related parties who worked with him," Miyachi wrote.

The official X account for the Knight's & Magic anime also paid tribute , offering condolences on behalf of the staff.

Katsura's notable credits include character design and chief animation direction for Kono Naka ni Hitori, Imouto ga Iru! ( NAKAIMO - My Little Sister Is Among Them! ) and Synduality: Noir . He also served as the chief animation director for Grisaia no Kajitsu , Grisaia no Meikyuu , and Grisaia no Rakuen .

Katsura also directed and designed the characters for the Utawarerumono OVA in 2009-2010.

title: The Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter Releases Visual, Trailer and Staff Details
content:
Kadokawa has revealed a visual, a trailer, and production details for the upcoming anime The Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter ( Hone Dragon no Manamusume ). Kana Hanazawa and Kazuhiko Inoue will star as Eve and Nemu, the Skull Dragon. Doga Kobo ( Asteroid in Love , Oshi no Ko ) animates the adaptation. You can view the trailer below.

Additional production staff for the Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter includes

• Tomo Atsumi — Character Design

• Yuka Yamada — Series Composition

• Daiki Kuribayashi — Background Art

• Yuki Hatakeyama — Background Art

Both voice actors shared their excitement about the adaptation, with Kana Hanazawa stating:

“Seeing the preciousness of everyday life with someone you care about brought to life in such a heartfelt animation is almost too much—in the best way. As I read the original work, I’ve tried to portray Eve in a way that honors how freely and wholeheartedly she lives. I think it’s turned out beautifully, and I can’t wait for everyone to see it!!!” *

Kazuhiko Inoue said,

“It’s a lovely, gentle series—the kind that soothes you just by watching. I’ve been cast as Nemu, a role that feels like a perfect fit for someone who’s always sleepy, like me. I’m looking forward to bringing out the warm bond that grows between Nemu and Eve, and I’ll give the recording my very best. I hope you’re excited to see it!” *

The Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter follows the skull dragon, Nemu, and the orphan Eve.

After a long life, Nemu, the dragon, is approaching his final sunset. The old dragon spends his final days sleeping in the Forest of Scraps. But when a five-year-old orphan named Eve finds him, he adopts her, bringing his lonely days to an end. However, after half a decade together, Nemu closes his eyes for the last time. Yet their story doesn’t end. Months after his death, Nemu revives him as a skull dragon! And with life blooming again, Nemu vows to help Eve control her powers before his new existence fades.

As part of the promotion campaign for The Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter , the show’s production committee is raffling three postcards (by lottery) autographed by Kana Hanazawa and Kazuhiko Inoue. Fans can enter the raffle by following the anime’s X account and retweeting the campaign post. The lottery runs until 11:59 pm on October 22, 2026 (JST).

Ichi Yukishir launched The Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter on Mag Garden’s Mag Comi manga website in September 2020. After two years of serialization in that magazine, the manga moved to Monthly Comic Garden in January 2022. Monthly Comic Garden serialized the manga until its conclusion in August 2025. Mag Garden compiled the manga into six volumes.

Seven Seas Entertainment released the manga in English in both digital and print editions.

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Anime's 1st Teaser Previews Voice Cast
content:
Crunchyroll unveiled a new teaser trailer for the television anime of Kashiko Amane 's Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret ( Hōkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ) manga on Thursday. The teaser shows the first footage of the anime and previews the voice cast. The anime's official website also streamed the teaser. ( Crunchyroll 's upload of the teaser has English subtitles but is region-locked, while the official Japanese upload has no region locking.)

Yen Press publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

The anime's cast members include:

Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno

Hikaru Tōno as Rei Kuromiya

=LOVE idol group member Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You , Dropkick on My Devil! ) is directing the anime at Gekkō , and Fumihiko Shimo ( BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. , Full Metal Panic! , Infinite Stratos ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. Kibidango 14-gō ( Azuma Tozawa , Wash It All Away ) is designing the characters. Satoru Kōsaki ( The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya , Monogatari Series, Aharen-san wa Hakarenai ) and monaca ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , Star Driver , Wake Up, Girls! ) are composing the music. Ryō Aizawa ( Starry Cube ) is producing.

The anime will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs in Japan.

Amane has been serializing the manga on Hakusensha 's Young Animal Web site since September 2022, and Hakusensha published the ninth volume this past July. Yen Press published the fourth manga volume in June.

title: 'Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, Second Promo
content:
The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 unveiled additional cast, a second key visual (pictured right), the opening theme, and second promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Haka Tokura and Shin Arakawa 's Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made ( Magical Buffs: The Support Caster Is Stronger Than He Realized! ) manga on Thursday. The anime series will be broadcast on Tokyo MX, MBS, and BS11 on January 4, 2027.

Cast Abel: Haruki Ishiya ( Marriagetoxin ) Mark: Atsushi Ono ( Re:Creators ) Monica: Yui Ishikawa ( Shingeki no Kyojin )

Singer-songwriter LiSA ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) is performing the opening theme "Ecstatic Buffer," which previewed in the second promotional video below.

Hideki Okamoto ( 2.5-jigen no Ririsa ) is directing the series at J.C.Staff . Takao Yoshioka ( Horimiya ) is handling series composition and Yuu Murakami ( Nanatsu no Maken ga Shihai suru animation director) is designing the characters. Yuuki Hayashi ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ), Luke Standridge , and Asa Taylor ( Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku. ) are composing the music.

Arakawa began serializing the manga adaptation of Tokura’s action fantasy novel on the Gaugau Monster web service in September 2021. The 12th volume went on sale on August 28.

Tokura originally began writing the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in November 2020. Futabasha began publishing the light novel under its Monster Novel imprint with illustrations by Eiri Shirai in September 2021. The fourth volume went on sale on June 30.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed both the light novel and manga in English in May 2025 and May 2024, respectively. The second novel volume shipped on June 16, with the third volume scheduled to be released on October 27. The seventh manga volume went on sale on September 22, with the eighth planned to be released on January 19, 2027.

title: Now That We Draw Reveals Opening Song
content:
The production committee behind Now That We Draw has revealed the opening song for the upcoming ecchi rom-com. Shallm will perform “Kimiiro Hirari.” The band debuted the song during a performance on their ANTI AFTER SCHOOL EP tour.

Of the OP, Lia, Shallm’s vocalist, said

“I’m truly delighted and honored to work on the opening for Now That We Draw ( Kakunaru Ue wa ) . After reading the original work, I felt not only its charm as a rom-com but also the wonder of chasing dreams together with someone. Since I’m pursuing my dreams, I could relate to the two protagonists on many levels. I created the song while cherishing the emotions the manga gave me. I’d be happy if you enjoy “Kimiiro Hirari” along with the series.”

Now That We Draw premieres in January 2027. The anime’s production committee previously announced the production staff and leading VAs. Studio ROLL2 will animate Kakunaru Ue wa. S hunsuke Ishikawa will direct the anime. Additional production staff includes

• Arei Saiga — Art Director

• Deko Akao — Script & Series Composition

• Fumiyuki Gou — Sound Director

• Hayato Kifune — Director of Photography

• Hiromi Nakagawa — Character Design

• Mai Hasegawa — Editing

• Momoka Izumi — Character Design

• Ryuuta Nakahara — Sound Effects

• Yurie Matsuura — Color Design

• Yoshiaki Miura — Music

Ayumu Murase and Niina Miyamoto will voice Ayumu Murase and Sayumi Suzushiro. View the previously released trailer below.

Now That We Draw follows Yuuki Uehara and Nina Miyamoto, a duo of aspiring manga artists with a problem: their editors say the romance in their stories isn’t believable. But since they have never been in love, how can they remedy that? Well, they can pretend to be a couple!

Kakunaru Ue wa is based on the manga by Kyu Takahata and Yuwji Kaba. Young Animal magazine (Hakusensha) has serialized the manga since its February 2023 premiere. The ongoing manga currently boasts eight volumes. Seven Seas Entertainment has published the first six volumes of the manga in English.
